## About
Allied Body & Frame is a neighborhood auto body shop at 1375 San Pablo Avenue in Berkeley. Peter Brisbo worked as the shop's manager before becoming the owner, and the same core team has stayed with him. Our customers are also our neighbors, and we stand by all of our work.
We take on everything from full collision repair to refinishing, on Asian, European and domestic cars. Our technicians keep current with training from I/CAR Collision Repair Training and the National Institute of Automotive Service Excellence.
We're rated 4.9 from 32 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that you usually speak directly with the owner or the manager. Another said Peter and his team have been their preferred choice whenever they needed auto body repairs.

## Services
- Collision repair: Full collision repair, from minor damage to major repairs, on Asian, European and domestic cars.
- Refinishing: Refinishing services, along with everything in between, so your car comes back looking right.
- Help with your insurance company: We assist with communication and protocol with your insurance company, as needed.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with AAA?
A: Yes. We are a provider in the AAA Direct Repair Network. We use digital imagery and communicate electronically with AAA directly.

Q: Can I get a rental car while my car is in the shop?
A: A rental car facility is within walking distance of the shop, and pick-up and return service is available.
